{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-07",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-07 configures Visit 8.1 at Day 91 with a window of ±1 day and label 'Visit 8.1 (PK 504h)'. According to Table 1 (p. 44) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51), Visit 8.1 is on Day 90 (480 h after the 6th administration on Day 70) with an allowed window of ±2 days."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-08",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-08 adds '504 h' to the PKTPT codelist instead of '480 h', contradicting the 6th-dose PK sampling schedule on pages 27 and 51 (480 h / Day 90 after start of 6th administration). In addition, the cited quote on page 27 only lists 1st-dose timepoints and does not support the 6th-dose timepoint."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-02",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-02 creates Visit 2.2 (Day 6) without an allowed visit window, whereas Table 1 (p. 44) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51, ±24 hour for 144 h) specify an allowed window of ±1 day."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-03",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-03 creates Visit 2.3 (Day 10) without an allowed visit window, whereas Table 1 (p. 44) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51, ±24 hour for 240 h) specify an allowed window of ±1 day."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-06",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-06 creates Visit 7.3 (Day 80) without an allowed visit window, whereas Table 1 (p. 44) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51, ±24 hour for 240 h) specify an allowed window of ±1 day."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-05",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-05 creates Visit 7.2 (Day 76, 144 h post-6th dose) without a visit window, matching the blank window cell in Table 1 (p. 44), whereas Section 6.2.5 (p. 51) specifies an acceptable time window of ±24 hours (±1 day) for 144 h post-dosing."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-01",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-01 through OP-06 cite only the sentence 'At Visits 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 7.1, 7.2, 7,3, and 8.1, no other data will be collected' on page 51, which does not state the study day numbers, treatment period grouping, or PK hour labels (e.g., Day 2, Day 72) found in Table 1 on page 44."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-8",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-16",
      "change_id": "CH-16",
      "page": 50,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-16 assigns the ADA form to V2 and V9 in addition to V3, V4, V6, and V8, but its cited quote on page 50 ('Blood sampling for anti-TJ301 antibodies (Visits 3, 4, 6, and 8)') does not support V2 or V9 (which are specified in Table 1 on page 45, Section 6.2.3 on page 50, and Section 6.3 on page 52)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-9",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-19",
      "change_id": "CH-26",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-17 through OP-19 create a new DIARY form and assign it only to V2, omitting all other visits where diary dispensing and/or review are required per Table 1 (p. 44: V1, V1.1, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, and V8). Furthermore, OP-18 combines dispensing and review into a single Yes/No item, which cannot distinguish visits where both occur (V1.1–V7) from visits with dispensing only (V1) or review only (V8)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-10",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-3",
      "page": 7,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "CH-3 requires FDA-defined remission at Week 12 ('Stool frequency subscore=0, Rectal bleeding subscore=0, and Endoscopy subscore =0 or 1') as well as modified Mayo score and PGA score endpoints, but neither the existing casebook (which only has total scores MAYOTOT and PMAYOTOT) nor the diff captures the Stool frequency subscore or Rectal bleeding subscore."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-11",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-21",
      "change_id": "CH-8",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "The protocol is internally inconsistent on the allowable window for screening endoscopy: Inclusion Criterion 4 (p. 34), Table 1 footnote c (p. 45), and Section 6.2.2 bullet 9 (p. 49) specify Day -35 to Day -6 (or within 35 days before Randomisation in footnote b), whereas the second paragraph on page 49 still states 'Endoscopy conducted within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable'."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-12",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-20",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-20 triggers the PK subgroup visits solely when '$V2.RAND.PKSUB = \"Yes\"' (consent to participate in PK substudy), whereas Section 6.2.5 (p. 51) and Section 4.2.2 (p. 37) state that only 24 patients in Mainland China electronically assigned/randomised to the PK subgroup enter the PK subgroup, and the cited quote on page 51 does not mention consent or randomisation."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-13",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-22",
      "change_id": null,
      "page": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-22 modifies rule CMP_PK_01 without citing any source_change_ids, source_page, or source_quote."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-14",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-23",
      "change_id": null,
      "page": null,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-23 updates review plan SDV100 without citing any source_change_ids, source_page, or source_quote."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-15",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-12",
      "page": 35,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "CH-12 expands Exclusion Criterion 17 to exclude latent TB based on QuantiFERON-TB Gold at Screening or a T-spot test within 4 weeks of Randomisation plus chest X-ray within 12 weeks of Randomisation, but no operation adds chest X-ray capture or distinguishes TB test modality/dates beyond the single text field TB.TBRES."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "I could not verify whether patient diary subscores (stool frequency and rectal bleeding) or central endoscopy readings are captured in external eCOA/central-lab systems rather than the EDC casebook, nor could I verify the exact expression syntax semantics of `days_between` and `$V2.DATE` in rule CMP_ENDO_01."
}
